mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( IMGKEY INT NOT NULL, GROUP_KEY VARCHAR2(100), GROUP_CNT VARCHAR2(1), STATUS VARCHAR2(1) DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, RSLT VARCHAR2(10), RSLTDESC VARCHAR2(1000), SENDABLE VARCHAR2(1) DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL, BRAND_ID VARCHAR2(100) NOT NULL, IMG_PATH VARCHAR2(128), IMG_ID VARCHAR2(100), MEDIA_URL VARCHAR2(256), REQDATE DATE NOT NULL, RPTDATE DATE, TEMPLATE_YN VARCHAR2(1) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_${tableName} PRIMARY KEY (IMGKEY) )
mapper.select: SELECT /* +RULE*/ IMGKEY AS key, IMG_PATH AS image_path, IMG_ID AS file_id, BRAND_ID, REQDATE AS request_date, TEMPLATE_YN FROM ${tableName} WHERE STATUS = '0' AND SENDABLE = 'N' AND REQDATE < SYSDATE AND ROWNUM <= 100
SELECT IMGKEY AS key FROM ${tableName} WHERE STATUS = '1' AND REQDATE < SYSDATE - 30 / 24 / 60 / 60 AND ROWNUM <= 100
